subject: Re: Kickoff: romanized Hindi/Urdu routing
body:
Closing this one out -- decisions:

1. The three-class design (hi / ur / ambiguous with locale fallback) was the right call. Approved in March, and the integration numbers vindicate it: routing accuracy on live romanized traffic improved 11% with zero increase in user-visible transliteration complaints during the two-week canary.
2. The combined gen_train + mc4_train model at 91.2% topline is what ships. No further tuning this window.
3. Follow-ups logged for Q3: the mc4 refresh ingestion Rafael filed, and a look at extending the seed-word approach to other romanized pairs.

Wrapped three days early, cleanly. Thank you all -- this is the kind of small project that quietly fixes an entire user experience.

Priya
